name: discord
description: Discord bot guild workflows, personal DM routing and complete bot/MCP setup.3 full heads; no automatic provider registration.

interface.shortDescription: Guild tools and careful personal DM routing
interface.longDescription: Find and summarize Discord channel conversations, prepare replies, and send authorized messages with the correct identity. Search indexed guild conversations or read a focused current channel/thread. Draft a reply from the relevant conversation context. Send an explicitly authorized bot message, or use the narrow personal-account UI route when appropriate. Start with a concrete task or ask what this plugin can do. The MCP speaks as a bot. It does not inherit your personal account or all your DMs. Indexed history can be stale; a plugin installation does not prove bot access.
defaultPrompt: Find the latest discussion in a Discord channel.
Draft a reply to this Discord message.
